speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are suffering from sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg. To help me pinpoint the cause, can you tell me exactly where the pain starts in your back and where it travels? Also, on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sciatica (Lumbar Radiculopathy). Given the sudden onset during exercise and radiation to the foot, I suspect a lumbar disc herniation. Could you tell me if you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg or foot?
